why: Mana pass on the proposed v1.1.0 list (cart-v1), 2026-09-11: 35 lands with seven that always enter tapped, one fetch and no shocks, red 16 and green 11 sources short of Karsten targets on double-pip Dinosaurs, lands-only on-curve R 52% G 64%. Three taplands out for three shocks (tempo: always-tapped 7 -> 4; a dual is a dual to the source count) and three basics out for three fetches that reach every shock (colour: R 52 -> 58%, G 64 -> 69%, W 83 -> 87% on the mana tool). The goldfish cannot rank lands; mana-analysis is the evidence, and this objective (two dead turns in a row, 0.132 on cart-v1) is the one goldfish row a colour screw shows in.
